name: Common Stone
description: A simple stone. Even a dragon's hoard has filler.

name: Tarnished Coin
description: Old currency of a forgotten kingdom, still warm to the touch.

name: Cracked Gemstone
description: Flawed, but it still catches the firelight nicely.

name: Rusted Pauldron
description: A knight's shoulder-guard. The kobolds find it inspiring.

name: Rare Ruby
description: A ruby that glimmers with a fiery glow.

name: Silver Chalice
description: A ceremonial cup worth a small fortune.

name: Jade Idol
description: A carved figure the kobolds revere; they work harder near it.

name: Moonstone Ring
description: It sharpens the senses — and the claws.

name: Mystic Sapphire
description: A sapphire that holds the secrets of the universe.

name: Enchanted Amulet
description: An amulet that grants the wearer protection and luck.

name: Obsidian Crown
description: A crown of volcanic glass, heavy with old authority.

name: Dragonbone Relic
description: A shard of an ancestor's wing. The brood snaps to attention.

name: Starlit Orb
description: Captured starlight that whispers of greater hoards to come.

name: Ancient Golden Goblet
description: A goblet that shines with the light of a thousand suns.

name: Philosopher's Hoard
description: A vault-in-a-box that quietly multiplies whatever it touches.

name: Worldheart Diamond
description: The single greatest gem ever unearthed. Kingdoms would burn for it.
